            - paragraph [ref=e417]:
              - text: The cat (
              - generic [ref=e418]: Felis catus
              - text: ), also called domestic cat and house cat, is a small domesticated
              - link "carnivorous" [ref=e419] [cursor=pointer]:
                - /url: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Carnivore
              - text: mammal. It is a member of
              - link "Felidae" [ref=e420] [cursor=pointer]:
                - /url: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Felidae
              - text: ", the family of mammals in the"
              - link "order" [ref=e421] [cursor=pointer]:
                - /url: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Order_(taxonomy)
              - link "Carnivora" [ref=e422] [cursor=pointer]:
                - /url: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Carnivora
              - text: also colloquially referred to as cats. An
              - link "obligate carnivore" [ref=e423] [cursor=pointer]:
                - /url: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Obligate_carnivore
              - text: ", requiring a predominantly meat-based diet, it has retractable"
              - link "claws" [ref=e424] [cursor=pointer]:
                - /url: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Claw
              - text: adapted to killing small prey species such as
              - link "mice" [ref=e425] [cursor=pointer]:
                - /url: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mice
              - text: and
              - link "rats" [ref=e426] [cursor=pointer]:
                - /url: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rat
              - text: . It has a strong, flexible body, quick
              - link "reflexes" [ref=e427] [cursor=pointer]:
                - /url: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Reflex
              - text: ", and sharp teeth, and its"
              - link "night vision" [ref=e428] [cursor=pointer]:
                - /url: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Night_vision
              - text: and
              - link "sense of smell" [ref=e429] [cursor=pointer]:
                - /url: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sense_of_smell
              - text: are well developed. It is a
              - link "social species" [ref=e430] [cursor=pointer]:
                - /url: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Social_species
              - text: ", but a solitary hunter and a"
              - link "crepuscular" [ref=e431] [cursor=pointer]:
                - /url: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Crepuscular
              - link "predator" [ref=e432] [cursor=pointer]:
                - /url: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Predator
              - text: .
              - link "Cat communication" [ref=e433] [cursor=pointer]:
                - /url: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cat_communication
              - text: includes
              - link "meowing" [ref=e434] [cursor=pointer]:
                - /url: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Meow
              - text: ","
              - link "purring" [ref=e435] [cursor=pointer]:
                - /url: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Purr
              - text: ", trilling,"
              - link "hissing" [ref=e436] [cursor=pointer]:
                - /url: https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/hiss
              - text: ","
              - link "growling" [ref=e437] [cursor=pointer]:
                - /url: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Growling
              - text: ","
              - link "grunting" [ref=e438] [cursor=pointer]:
                - /url: https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/grunt
              - text: ","
              - link "body language" [ref=e439] [cursor=pointer]:
                - /url: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cat_body_language
              - text: ", and"
              - link "scent marking" [ref=e440] [cursor=pointer]:
                - /url: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Scent_rubbing
              - text: . It can hear sounds too faint or too high in
              - link "frequency" [ref=e441] [cursor=pointer]:
                - /url: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Frequency
              - text: for human ears, such as those made by
              - link "small mammals" [ref=e442] [cursor=pointer]:
                - /url: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Small_mammal
              - text: . It secretes and perceives
              - link "pheromones" [ref=e443] [cursor=pointer]:
                - /url: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pheromone
              - text: .
              - link "Cat intelligence" [ref=e444] [cursor=pointer]:
                - /url: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cat_intelligence
              - text: is evident in its ability to adapt, learn through observation, and solve problems. The domestic cat is the only
              - link "domesticated" [ref=e445] [cursor=pointer]:
                - /url: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Domestication
              - link "species" [ref=e446] [cursor=pointer]:
                - /url: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Species
              - text: of the family Felidae.
